title: D1 complete passport notices
description: Authored English and Spanish notice templates for the complete D1 candidate. Preferred-language key selection, qualified operation facts, server-computed dates, delivery, queueing and notice-sent receipts require host execution; this file establishes none of those outcomes. Ten days is an explicitly labeled dispute-period sample. No business calendar is selected, so this file does not redefine P90D/P10D as business days.

d1PhotoRequestEnUS.description: D1 complete PhotoRequest notice, authored en-US text. Render only after the corresponding qualified operation.
d1PhotoRequestEnUS.subject: We need more information — reference {{referenceNumber}}

sections.title: What happened
sections.content: Notice date: {{noticeDate}}. We need a new photo for your passport application. Your case is waiting for you; active processing is paused.

sections.title: Why
sections.content: Requested items: {{requestedItems}}. Reason: {{requestReason}}. Photo example: {{photoExampleUrl}}.

sections.title: What you need to do
sections.content: Open {{responseUrl}} and replace only the requested photo. Your earlier answers stay visible and unchanged. If you can't get this, tell us and we'll help.

sections.title: Send by
sections.content: {{sendBy}} ({{daysRemaining}} days left). The response period is 90 days from the qualifying notice-sent date. If you do not respond in time, your application will be denied for no response.

sections.title: Get free help
sections.content: Free help: {{freeHelpContact}}. You can also respond on paper or in person: {{paperOrInPersonInstructions}}. Free language assistance: {{freeHelpContact}}. Ayuda gratuita en su idioma: {{freeHelpContact}}.

d1OutsideDataDisputeEnUS.subject: Check outside information — reference {{referenceNumber}}

sections.title: What happened
sections.content: Notice date: {{noticeDate}}. We received outside information that may affect your application. We have not treated it as confirmed with you.

sections.title: Why
sections.content: Source: {{outsideDataSource}}. Information date: {{outsideDataAsOf}}. Information to check: {{outsideDataSummary}}.

sections.title: What you need to do
sections.content: Review the information at {{responseUrl}}. Tell us what is incorrect and provide any supporting evidence. If you can't get this, tell us and we'll help.

sections.title: Send by
sections.content: {{sendBy}} ({{daysRemaining}} days left). This demo uses a 10-day sample dispute period. A qualified program rule takes precedence; this sample is not a universal legal deadline. We will not use unconfirmed outside information against you before the required notice and dispute period are satisfied.

sections.title: Get free help
sections.content: Free help: {{freeHelpContact}}. Paper or in-person response: {{paperOrInPersonInstructions}}. Free language assistance: {{freeHelpContact}}. Ayuda gratuita en su idioma: {{freeHelpContact}}.

d1NoResponseDeniedEnUS.subject: Decision on your application — denied for no response — reference {{referenceNumber}}

sections.title: What happened
sections.content: Decision date: {{decisionDate}}. Your application is closed and denied for no response.

sections.title: Why
sections.content: We requested {{requestedItems}} in the notice sent on {{noticeDate}}, for this reason: {{requestReason}}. The 90-day response period ended on {{sendBy}} without an accepted response.

sections.title: What you need to do
sections.content: Apply again with a new application and fees. Instructions: {{reapplicationInstructions}}. Late evidence can attach to this case, but it does not reopen the case automatically.

sections.title: Send by
sections.content: The previous response deadline was {{sendBy}}. This closed application has no new response deadline.

sections.title: If you disagree
sections.content: You can't ask for a hearing on this decision. Reopening requires an authorized Adjudicator and a recorded reason.

sections.title: Get free help
